issue.title: SIGABRT when destructing mavsdk
issue.body:
In order to start fresh after detecting a disconnect (we want to reconnect on a potentially different IP address), we have to destruct the mavsdk object and create a brand new one. However, I have seen 2 exceptions come up when destructing the mavsdk.

I have attached a CMakeLists.txt and relevant minimal examples. Change the source `.txt` files to `.cpp`. Here is the CMake line:
`cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=install -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug ..`

It is also worth noting that I am connecting to the simulator using a remote port and UDP. Usage is similar to `mavsdk_server`:
`case1 udp://<url>:14540`. I am also using a REQUIRED code change from [this PR](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/pull/2074) to allow the UDP disconnect to be properly recognized.

1. When registering on the `subscribe_is_connected` and then killing the simulator after a successful connection, I get a SIGABRT on [this line](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/ea0b720538cff8e51947557234cb9c4300edadc3/src/mavsdk/core/mavsdk_impl.cpp#L53). I made sure to unsubscribe from all subscriptions before destructing the mavsdk, but it still seems to be holding onto something. The error on screen is `libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::__1::system_error: thread::join failed: Resource deadlock avoided`. I have attached this as case1.cpp. This code gives you 120 seconds to kill the simulator and detect the failure.
2. After the mavsdk is destructed, it looks like the system_thread is still running, but the `_parent.time` has been uninitialized and leads to a `EXC_BAD_ACCESS (code=1, address=0x10)` exception on [this line](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/ea0b720538cff8e51947557234cb9c4300edadc3/src/mavsdk/core/mavsdk_time.cpp#L45).

[CMakeLists.txt](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/files/11702438/CMakeLists.txt)
[case2.txt](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/files/11702441/case2.txt)
[case1.txt](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/files/11702442/case1.txt)

Initial discussion conducted on [discord](https://discord.com/channels/1022170275984457759/1116075629008392314)

I was using a slightly older version previously, it looks like case2 has been fixed since then. However case1 is still present.

issue.title: UDP connection can disconnect when heartbeats are not received

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body: Creating a UDP connection to a vehicle/simulator via `setup_udp_remote` or `add_any_connection` will set the `always_connected` flag to true in all cases. This means that even though MAVSDK could be sending heartbeats (configured in the `Mavsdk::Configuration::_always_send_heartbeats`), the lack of response on those heartbeats does not lead to realizing/announcing the disconnect. With this change, if the Mavsdk will properly use heartbeats to detect connection and disconnection if it is configured to send those heartbeats. This means that the system will not be considered connected (and fire the `subscribe_on_new_system` callback) until the first heartbeat response is received, and will be considered disconnected (and fire the `subscribe_is_connected` callback) when the configured amount of time passes without a heartbeat response.

issue.title: examples: add disconnection example

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This is an example how to destruct Mavsdk when a system has disconnected.

Thanks to @jperez-droneup for creating the initial version of this example in https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/2075.

Note, I also tried to run this 3 times and then break out of the while with valgrind and it showed no leaks, so that makes me hopeful. There have been quite a few destruction bugs in the past but thanks to the system tests which create and destruct `Mavsdk` and `System`s all the time I was able to catch quite a few of them.
